value.title: Collect six native harness formats through pure adapters
value.summary: Six pure native harness mappers, shared revision-snapshot storage and explicit SDK/CLI/catalog composition; preserve native evidence and honest fidelity boundaries.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Six pure native harness mappers, shared revision-snapshot storage and explicit SDK/CLI/catalog composition; preserve native evidence and honest fidelity boundaries.

sections.name: goals
value: Export Codex, Oh My Pi, Pi, Copilot CLI, VS Code Copilot and Cursor using explicit sources and shared ports.
Run independent mappers concurrently; isolate shared snapshot/SQLite storage from ready JSONL lanes.

sections.name: non_goals
value: No private content capture in fixtures, implicit scans, plugin runtime, daemon or network dependency.
No automatic main landing, remote publication or workspace retirement; no lossless/final-session claim.

value.claim: The Codex adapter maps supported observed native messages/tools/model/usage/identity deterministically through pure shared contracts, exports via SDK/CLI and has accurate catalog hints plus a classified per-dialect fidelity report; unsupported variants are explicit, never silent lossless claims.

The Cursor adapter maps supported observed native messages/tools/model/usage/identity deterministically through pure shared contracts, exports via SDK/CLI and has accurate catalog hints plus a classified per-dialect fidelity report; unsupported variants are explicit, never silent lossless claims.

Native JSON snapshots, mutation journals and SQLite key/value stores are read through a shared bounded explicit-source loader with consistent revision identity, not fake LF offsets. VSCode patches are reduced under an evidenced pure state contract before message projection.

Changed snapshots, deleted native entries, delayed appends and source incompleteness remain observable with provenance; checkpoint publication follows successful output only and repeated cumulative usage is never silently summed.

All six isolated mapper owners can implement against frozen core types/fakes without sibling implementation dependencies; app registration, core changes, lockfile and final composition have one PM owner.

Actual synthetic end-to-end SDK/CLI exports and catalog output preserve privacy policy and prior Claude/configuration behavior; all shipping adapters satisfy source-purity/architecture checks and independent Opus review.

value.title: Implement native mappers and shared snapshot storage

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Standing operator grant: yes, fan out the work effectiely. Existing six-format research is evidence input, not work to repeat. Cursor transcripts/IDE/opaque CLI stores and VSCode snapshots/journals remain distinctly documented dialects. Harness-engineering is inspiration, not authority.

value.notes: Workers author complete mappers, deterministic synthetic fixtures and boundary regressions without running validation. PM runs scoped tests, single coordinated quality/build lane and actual external SDK/installed CLI exports; independent Opus/high review.

sections.name: implementation_summary
sections.value: All six native applications, nine registrations and ten representation cases are implemented and independently approved at product c6f3636b. No new ingestion scope, restart or retirement.
